summary: Iteration 6: Portal flow end-to-end (parent appointment requests, doctor confirm/decline, portal invite, Appointment.date model, tenant isolation). Backend 14/14 pytest pass. Frontend parent + doctor smoke: parent creates request from /portale (Bilancio di salute), appears in Appuntamenti tab with status 'In attesa di conferma'; doctor dashboard shows portal-requests section with appt-requests-count=1, confirm button adjusts date→+7d, card disappears, upcoming-list fills (3 items) and shows success toast 'Appuntamento inserito in agenda · genitore avvisato'. 390px: zero horizontal overflow on both portal dialog and doctor portal-requests. Backend tests covered: RBAC (parent 403 on /api/appointment-requests, doctor 403 on /api/portal/appointment-requests); validation (wrong clinic 400, past date 422, bad time 422, child not linked 404); full confirm flow (create pending → shows in /portal/me requests → doctor lists → Foti CANNOT see or confirm (404 tenant isolation) → test_flowdoc confirms with new slot → confirmed_date persisted → re-confirm 404 → /appointments/upcoming contains new appt → parent /portal/me shows status 'confirmed' + appointment entry with date); decline flow + double-decline 404; Foti agenda still has 10 'today' appts (date=null); creating via POST /appointments auto-stamps today; portal invite: GET /register/invite/badtoken → 410, invite_token.py helper mints token → GET returns prefill (email, child CF BNCLRA21E45F158Y, patient_first 'TEST_'); POST /patients/{pid}/invite with valid HTTPS Origin → 200 {sent:true,to:parent}; same with http Origin → 400.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_flow.py:confirm() does not validate that body.date >= today (Slot validator covers it), but when the DOCTOR adjusts a slot into the past via /appointment-requests/{rid}/confirm the same Slot validator still fires → good (verified behavior consistent).

portal_flow.py:invite() rejects http Origin outright. The current preview is https-only so OK, but note that in a reverse-proxied dev environment the Origin header may be stripped — consider also accepting the Referer or env PUBLIC_URL as fallback to avoid 400s during local tests.

server.py:/appointments filter uses {date: {$in: [None, today_rome()]}}. New appointments created from the portal are inserted via portal_flow.py with body.date (never null), while /appointments POST defaults missing date to today. Keep an eye on migrations: any pre-existing seed with date=null will show up every day forever. Consider a one-shot backfill of null → today's seed date, then drop the None branch from the filter.

portal_flow.py:list_requests() uses `since = (_now() - timedelta(days=14)).isoformat()` compared to `decided_at`, which is also stored as .isoformat() UTC — lexicographic compare works because both strings are same length/offset. Document this assumption or switch to a Date field to avoid future bugs if timezone-aware strings vary.

portal_flow.py:MAX_PENDING=5 counts across ALL doctors for the parent (count_documents by parent_id only). If a parent has 2 children with 2 different doctors, 5 pending shared cap may be surprising. Acceptable business rule but worth confirming with product.
